// ==== HashOrder.cs ====
// Translated by CodeBreaker from HashOrder (java).
using System.Collections.Generic;

public class HashOrder
{
    public HashOrder()
    {
    }

    internal static int walk()
    {
        IDictionary<string, int> m = new JHashMap<string, int>();
        m["a"] = 1;
        int t = 0;
        foreach (int v in m.Values)
        {
            t += v;
        }
        return t;
    }

    internal static int sorted()
    {
        IDictionary<string, int> m = new SortedDictionary<string, int>(JLib.Order<string>());
        m["a"] = 1;
        int t = 0;
        foreach (int v in m.Values)
        {
            t += v;
        }
        return t;
    }
}
